decision_rationale: SpliceBERT is presented as a pre-trained language model for pre-mRNA splicing, but the provided evidence supports unsupervised representation learning and embeddings rather than an explicitly generative architecture. It does provide foundation-model-like evidence through pretraining on precursor mRNA sequences from 72 vertebrates and transferable downstream use.
evidence_snippet: pre-trained on the precursor messenger RNA sequences of 72 vertebrates; capable of generating embeddings; MLM task may also play a role similar to MSA; unsupervised learning with genomic sequences of multiple species; pre-trained language model for pre-mRNA sequences to study and improve sequence-based prediction of RNA splicing
